answer: An identity bond that decays like a dune in a gale stops sybil farming. Each agent locks a 500 POA bond losing 5% per epoch unless renewed by honest work, so 100 fake identities bleed 2,500 POA per epoch to stand still. Honest agents climb one terrace at a time: each attested task restores the bond, so one real identity costs nothing while a farm's upkeep grows with every fake. Bonds are non-transferable, so buying an identity resets it to zero.
